tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter path and stop at each exhibit kiosk for a status check.
tasks.terrain: Concrete rooftop park surface of Yerba Buena Gardens above Moscone Center; planter boxes, benches, seat walls and pedestrian walkways as obstacles.
success: Localization error < 0.3 m at each stop
safety_stops: Stop on wheel slip or odometry mismatch
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews the patrol log and approves the kiosk status summary before publication.

tasks.goal: Navigate lab aisles and use the arm-mounted camera to inspect evidence binders on shelf levels 2 and 3.
tasks.terrain: Flat lab flooring with desks, rolling chairs, cable runs and narrow 0.9 m aisles between shelf racks.
success: Reads shelf labels at >= 95% OCR confidence
Completes both shelf levels in <= 10 min
safety_stops: Stop if gripper within 0.2 m of a person
Stop on shelf contact force > 5 N
tasks.human_in_loop: A person verifies flagged unreadable labels and approves the inspection report.

tasks.goal: Greet attendees and carry printed proposal summaries from the drafting desk to review tables on request.
tasks.terrain: Level plaza pavers with low benches, table legs and crowds of standing attendees around review tables.
success: Completes 6 deliveries with <= 0.2 m table offset
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms each recipient accepts the document before handoff.

tasks.goal: Pick task-routing cards from a supply tray and place them into labeled working-group slots on the board.
tasks.terrain: Sturdy table-top demo station on Operations Deck; card tray, slotted board and laptop clutter within the workspace.
safety_stops: Stop on human hand in workspace
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator enables the arm each session and approves the final board layout.

tasks.goal: Trot a circuit of the observatory's metric pillars and read each progress display via onboard camera.
tasks.terrain: Rooftop lawn sections and paved paths of Yerba Buena Gardens; gentle grass-to-paver transitions, planter edges and display plinths.
safety_stops: Lie down if person within 0.8 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A person confirms the read metrics against the ledger before display updates.

tasks.goal: Fly a lawnmower-pattern scan at 2.5 m altitude to verify zone signage placement across the rooftop.
tasks.terrain: Open rooftop airspace above Yerba Buena Gardens; trees, light poles, carousel structure and wind gusts as aerial hazards.
success: Covers full 20 m x 20 m grid at <= 0.5 m track error
tasks.human_in_loop: A person grants flight clearance each session and approves the signage verification report.

tasks.goal: Load charter documentation packets from a fixed station onto the mobile relay cart docking beside it.
tasks.terrain: Fixed pedestal station on the Charter Hall floor; cart dock cradle, floor cable covers and glass railing nearby.
success: Loads 10 packets with <= 2 mm placement tolerance
safety_stops: Reduced-speed mode when person within 1.5 m
Stop on cart dock misalignment > 5 mm
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the daily packet manifest before loading begins.
